Baljee | num_employees = | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | website = {{url|royalorchidhotels.com}} | footnotes = }} '''Royal Orchid Hotels''' a [[hotel chain]] operating hotels in India, Sri Lanka and Nepal. == History == The first hotel was established in [[Bangalore]] in 1973 by Chander K. Baljee, starting with Hotel Harsha.{{cn|date=April 2024}} In 2001, the company opened The Royal Orchid, its flagship with 195 rooms on the KGA Golf Course in Bangalore and in 2008, Royal Orchid Hotels operated 15 hotels.{{cite web|url=http://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-royal-orchid-lines-up-six-new-hotels-1172513|title=Royal Orchid lines up six new hotels|website=Dnaindia.com|date=21 June 2008|author=Pooja Sarkar|access-date=1 October 2017}} By May 2015, the count of hotels rose to 28, including 10 owned by the company, and 18 managed through joint ventures or contracts.{{cite web|url=http://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/royal-orchid-hotels-targets-50-hotels-in-two-years-115052300672_1.html|title=Royal Orchid Hotels targets 50 hotels in two years|website=Business-standard.com|date=23 May 2015|access-date=1 October 2017}} In 2015, the Royal Orchid Hotels opened its first hotel outside of India, the Hotel Royal Orchid Azure in [[Nairobi]]. == Properties == As of 26 October 2019, Royal Orchid Hotels has 58 hotels under its fold with 3948 keys – just short of 4000 – out of which 47 are under management contract. As of February 18, 2024, there are over 100 Hotels and Resorts with more than 5900 rooms open and operating, under the brand.{{cn|date=April 2024}} ==See also== *[[Hotel]] *[[List of hotels]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.royalorchidhotels.com Official website] {{Portal bar|India|Hotels}} {{Hotel chains}} {{Tourism}} [[Category:Hotel chains in India]] [[Category:Companies based in Bengaluru]] [[Category:1973 establishments in Karnataka]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1973]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{India-hotel-stub}} {{India-company-stub}}
